title: Code and data for the article "Spanish validation of the PBAT and cross-country mapping of process-outcome networks using link community analysis"
description: Analysis code (R) and the Spanish Process-Based Assessment Tool (PBAT) validation data (N = 602) used in Goicoechea et al. (2026), Journal of Contextual Behavioral Science, 41, 101021. The code is released under the MIT licence and the Spanish data under CC BY 4.0; the Swedish item-level data included for the invariance analysis keep the terms of their original publication (Larsson and Sundström, 2024). See LICENSE and data/LICENSE.md in the archive.
